current.text: He has a calf strain and is out at least two weeks. Yahoo lists him as out.
He is the third or fourth string center. Sabonis starts, and Raynaud and Achiuwa are also ahead of him for backup minutes.
Do not draft or stash him. The experts say to avoid him.
The Kings are projected near the bottom of the league, and their poor coaching and front office make the rotation hard to predict.

durable.text: He is a defensive-minded energy big whose value comes from rebounds and blocks.
He makes no threes and scores very little.
He is a poor free throw shooter. He shot 40% from the line in Summer League. His low volume limits the damage to team FT%.

note: Yahoo values him at 0 USD and ranks him 196th, and ESPN has no price, so he will not be among our 144 drafted players. He is hurt and third or fourth on the center depth chart, so leave him on waivers. Check him only if injuries to the Kings bigs open real minutes. His 1.5 blocks and 7.5 rebounds in 20.7 minutes last season, with few turnovers, could help a blocks build as a short-term pickup.
